title: Plan preflight discards stderr, making every bun-test/typecheck failure undiagnosable
description:
OBSERVED LIVE 2026-07-20. A `cam plan 359` dispatch aborted with `.claude/.cam-plan-preflight-failed.json` step=bun-test. The marker's `detail` held 42145 chars of test-program stdout chatter (cam ship / cam run banners, CAM_ISSUE_RESULT lines) and contained NO verdict at all: zero matches for `Ran N tests`, `N pass`, `N fail`, or any failing-assertion output. The run could not be diagnosed. Two immediately-subsequent full runs from a shell were green (exit 0, 5148 pass / 0 fail, 67s), and a re-dispatch of the same `cam plan 359` passed preflight and proceeded to branch+implement.

ROOT CAUSE. src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts records only stdout:
  line 102: return { ok: false, step: 'typecheck', detail: typecheck.stdout.trim() };
  line 108: return { ok: false, step: 'bun-test', detail: tests.stdout.trim() };
Bun's test runner writes its failure report AND its summary line to STDERR, not stdout. So for the one step whose failures matter most, the marker preserves incidental program output and drops the entire reason. The same applies to the typecheck step and to the git steps at lines 77 and 83.

WHY IT MATTERS. Preflight is a hard gate on the whole loop: when it fails, no planner spawns and the cycle stops. A gate that halts the loop while discarding the failure reason cannot be acted on. In this incident the failure was non-reproducible, so stderr was the ONLY channel that could have explained it, and it was gone. The operator-facing blocker line the orchestrator surfaces at boot (`plan preflight failed: <step> - <detail first line>`) inherits the same emptiness.

SCOPE. Capture and persist stderr alongside stdout for every failing preflight step (git-checkout-main, git-pull, typecheck, bun-test). Prefer stderr in the marker `detail` when stdout carries no verdict, or record both under distinct fields. Confirm the spawnFn used by preflight actually pipes stderr rather than inheriting or discarding it. Keep the marker's existing schema contract for `step`/`writtenAt` so the orchestrator's boot-surfaced blocker line keeps working.

NOTE ON THE UNDERLYING RED. The one-off bun-test failure itself is NOT explained by this issue and is not claimed to be fixed by it. A plausible untested difference is that preflight runs `bun test` as a child of the live sidecar process while the suite itself spawns real tmux servers and real sidecars, versus a clean shell. Fixing stderr capture is the prerequisite for diagnosing that if it recurs.

spec.scope:
Make plan-preflight failures diagnosable by capturing and persisting stderr alongside stdout for the failing steps. THREE coordinated edits, nothing more.

(1) src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts:31 - add a REQUIRED `stderr: string` field to the PlanPreflightSpawnFn return type (currently `{ stdout: string; exitCode: number }`). REQUIRED, not optional: an optional field lets test fakes keep modelling a process that has no stderr, and this repo has twice shipped bugs from fixtures encoding a wrong process model. Update the two fake-spawn fixture arrays in test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts (:41, :56) to supply stderr on every entry.

(2) src/commands/sidecar.ts:2639-2645 - the production preflightSpawnFn already passes `stderr: 'pipe'` to Bun.spawnSync but never decodes r.stderr. Decode it with the same TextDecoder/Buffer guard already used for stdout on the adjacent line and return it.

(3) src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts - at the failing-step return sites, put a COMBINED stdout+stderr string into `detail` instead of `stdout.trim()` alone. Apply to: :77 git-checkout-main, :83 git-pull, :102 typecheck, :108 bun-test. Do NOT change :96 clean-tree, which legitimately reports git porcelain stdout and has no stderr verdict.

Follow the repo's existing inline convention rather than inventing a helper; there is no shared stdout+stderr utility and none should be added for four call sites. The closest precedents are src/release/ship-pr.ts:268 (preference-with-fallback) and src/commands/sidecar.ts:1102-1107 (concatenate). Concatenation is the correct shape here because a bun-test failure can legitimately write to BOTH streams and preferring one would drop the other; a preference chain is only right when one stream is expected to be empty.

Also correct the doc comment at src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts:22, which currently claims the spawn fn 'returns the combined stdout and exit code'. It was never combined, and that inaccurate comment is part of why the gap survived. State what is actually returned.

EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE: do NOT add any new field to the marker (PlanPreflightFailedMarker stays exactly `{ step, detail, writtenAt }`); do NOT touch src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts; do NOT touch truncatePreflightDetail; do NOT touch the orchestrator boot-contract templates or .claude/agents copies; do NOT change the loopSpawnFn at sidecar.ts:2629-2635 (it has the identical drop, but it is a different code path and out of scope). Do NOT attempt to diagnose or fix the underlying one-off bun-test red that motivated this issue: this change is the PREREQUISITE for diagnosing it if it recurs, and claiming otherwise would be an overclaim.
acceptanceCriteria: PlanPreflightSpawnFn's return type in src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts declares `stderr: string` as a REQUIRED (non-optional) property.
The production preflightSpawnFn in src/commands/sidecar.ts decodes r.stderr and returns it, using the same Buffer/TextDecoder guard already applied to stdout.
For a failing typecheck step, the returned PlanPreflightResult.detail contains text that was written to stderr only (proved by a unit test whose fake spawn returns empty stdout and non-empty stderr).

For a failing bun-test step, the returned PlanPreflightResult.detail contains text that was written to stderr only (proved by a unit test whose fake spawn returns empty stdout and a bun-style summary on stderr).
For a failing git-checkout-main step and a failing git-pull step, detail likewise includes stderr content (unit tests, same shape).
When a failing step writes to BOTH stdout and stderr, detail contains content from both streams (unit test).
The clean-tree step's detail remains stdout-only and its existing test at test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts:150 still passes unchanged.
The writer-params key set assertion at test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-postaudit.test.ts:421 (`['detail','step']`) still passes unmodified, proving no new marker field was introduced.
test/templates/orchestrator-boot.test.ts passes unmodified, proving the boot contract was not touched.
The doc comment at src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts:22 no longer claims the spawn fn returns 'combined stdout'; it accurately describes stdout, stderr and exitCode.
bun run typecheck is zero errors; bun test is zero fails; bun run check:all passes.
gotchas: CRUX: stderr is ALREADY piped by Bun at src/commands/sidecar.ts:2640 (`stderr: 'pipe'`); r.stderr is a populated Buffer that the closure simply never decodes. Do not rewrite the spawn call or change its options; only decode and return the value that is already being captured.

Making stderr REQUIRED on the spawn-fn type WILL break typecheck in test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts until the fixture arrays at :41 and :56 are updated. That breakage is intended and is the point: update the fixtures, do not weaken the type to optional to avoid it.

test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-postaudit.test.ts:421 asserts the marker writer-params key set is exactly ['detail','step']. Any new marker field breaks it. Combining into the existing detail string is what keeps this green: do not 'fix' that test.

test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts:208 currently feeds `stdout: '1 fail / 0 pass'` and asserts detail contains 'fail'. That test must keep passing; the new stderr-only tests are ADDITIONS, not replacements.

The marker reader at src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts:72-94 is whitelist-style and tolerates extra fields, so it would NOT have caught an accidental new field. Rely on the postaudit key-set test, not the reader, as the guard.

readPlanPreflightFailedMarker has ZERO production callers: the marker is read by the LLM orchestrator persona at boot via a markdown contract, not by src/. So the real consumer of `detail` is a human-facing blocker line rendered through truncatePreflightDetail (first line + ' (+N more)'). Ordering matters for that line: if stdout is incidental chatter and stderr holds the verdict, a naive stdout-then-stderr concatenation buries the verdict behind 42KB of noise and the operator-facing first line stays useless, which is exactly the reported failure. Choose the combination order so the diagnostic value survives truncation to a single first line, and state the reasoning in a comment.
src/commands/sidecar.ts:2629-2635 (loopSpawnFn) has the identical stderr drop. It is deliberately OUT OF SCOPE. Do not fix it here; if it merits a fix it is a separate issue.

Quality gates are `bun run typecheck`, `bun test`, `bun run check:all`. No vendor/templates change is expected, so embed-vendor should NOT be needed; if you find yourself needing it, you have touched a template and gone out of scope.
domainTerms: plan preflight: the hard gate run before a planner subagent spawns (git-checkout-main, git-pull, clean-tree, typecheck, bun-test). On failure no planner spawns and the cycle stops.
preflight marker: .claude/.cam-plan-preflight-failed.json, shape { step, detail, writtenAt }, written by the sidecar and read only by the orchestrator persona at boot.
truncatePreflightDetail: renders detail as its first line plus ' (+N more)' for the operator-facing blocker line.
